about_the_game:
What is the meaning of Astra?

Astra is a voice assistant to control your PC. It automates working with your computer, opens your favorite apps and websites, finds answers to your questions, or plays videos on request. Using modern technologies (AI), Astra can also answer any question and even have a conversation on any topic.

Moreover, Astra has its own virtual model, which enhances the feeling of talking to a real person, ensuring more natural and personal interaction.

Why use Astra?

Astra is a smart and friendly voice assistant who will become your reliable companion in everyday tasks. New looks and voice styles will appear in the future, so stay tuned!

Smart, Lively, and Real

Astra was created with one goal — to add warmth and soulfulness to communicating with technology. We made the interface simple and intuitive so you can focus on what matters most: a comfortable and pleasant interaction.

Astra doesn’t just execute commands — she talks to you. You can customize her voice, personality, and visuals to make her exactly the virtual friend you want to see.

Every feature of Astra is designed to help rather than distract. Whether it’s work, study, or leisure, Astra is always there to make your day a little easier and warmer. Your new voice companion is already waiting for you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (Build 17763), 64-bit operating system
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Control your PC with the best voice assistant – Astra. Automate basic tasks and decorate your PC with super-cute characters. Bring your desktop to life with a new friend!

English*, Russian*, Ukrainian*
